definitions.full: H3621. Kelubay כְּלוּבָ֑י proper name, masculine a son of Hezron of Judah , according to 1Chr 2:9 ( ᵐ5 Ξαβελ , A Ξαλεβ , ᵐ5 L Ξαλωβι ), = כָּלֵב 2:18 etc. (see כָּלֵב 2 ).

occurrences.englishText: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
